description.narrative:
Objectives: 1. To foster collaboration, co-creation and a sense of community among young people across Africa and Europe to addressglobal challenges. 2. To catalyse and empower young people with the skills, knowledge, and resources needed to create positive change in their communities. 3. To support youth-led influencing activities in which young people raise their voices and share their solutions with decision-makers and other stakeholders at different levels. 4. To contribute to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by supporting youth-led initiatives and projects.
Deliverables/Activities: 1. Organize Eight (8) Monthly OnlineExchanges: We will facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration among the cohort of grantees across Africa and Europe through at least eight monthly online meetings or webinars focusing on a specific theme relevant to the project's goals. This is to encourage cross-cultural understanding, sharing of best practices, and collective problem-solving. This action will be carried out between June2025 to April 2026. 2. Commemorate Four (4) International Days: We will raise awareness and promote discussions on key internationaldays related to the project's themes through online events, webinars, or social media campaigns centred around specific UN, AU, andEU international days. In particular, we will organize online webinars on EU Day (9thMay), AU Day (25th May), International Youth Day (12th August), and International Day of Education (24th January). This is to foster global citizenship,educate participants aboutcritical issues, and inspire action. 3. Develop Two (2) Policy Briefs: We will provide informative documents on policy issuesrelevant to the objectives of this project in the form of written analyses that summarize key points, challenges, and recommendations. We will produce at least 2 policy briefs. One will be produced within the first half of the project year (May to October 2025),while the last one will be produced within the second half of the project year(November 2025 to April 2026). This is to inform decision-makers, stakeholders, and the public about critical policy matters. 4. Deliver 3 Specialised Workshops and Offer Technical Aid to Consortium Partners and Cohort of Grantees: We will offer expert guidance and support to consortium partners and the cohort of grantees, to ensure successful project implementation. This will be done through tailored advice, training sessions, and mentoring. Specifically, we will organise three (3) specialised training for the grantees covering topics on project management, financial literacy, advocacy and community engagement, among others. This training will be conducted every quarter throughout the project year (May2025 - April 2026). This is to enhance the capacity of grantees, improve project delivery,and foster sustainability. 5. Development of Progress Reports, Final Reports, Evaluation Reports, and Other Relevant Reports: We will document project progress, achievements, challenges, and lessons learned through written reports and a comprehensive final report. We will provide a monthly progress report (May 2025- May 2026), mid-term reports (October 2025), endline report (May 2026), and evaluation report (May 2026). This is to ensure accountability, transparency, and informed decision-making. 6. Resource Hub for Consortium Partners and Cohort of Grantees: We will serve as the centre for accessing relevant project information, tools, and resources. We will run an online repository or portal containing documents, guidelines, and multimedia materials relevant to the project. This activity will run for the entire duration of the project enhancing the overall efficiency of the project. 7. Moderation of Online Groups: We will ensure productive and respectful discussions within the Power to Voices platform and other online forums or groups related to the project. We will do this through active monitoring and guidance of online conversations to maintain focus and decorum. We will also share articles and blog posts to keep the platform energised. This activity will run for the entire duration of the project, promoting a positive online community. 8. Conduct Advocacy Visits to Relevant Stakeholders: We will conduct advocacy visits to relevant stakeholders such as AU and EU representatives at national and regional levels, as well as, embassies of African and European countries to share the policy briefs and discuss lessons from the project, influencing policy and decision-making at various levels. This will strengthen partnerships and collaborations with key stakeholders and increase awareness of the project's findings and recommendations. This advocacy will be conducted at the end of the project and beyond. 9. Capacity building for Staff and Development of BBFORPEACE Strategic Plan(2026-2031): We will develop a comprehensive five-year organizational strategic plan that aligns with our mission, vision, and goals. This will be achieved through situational analysis, stakeholder engagement, and review of existing plans and documents. This will be done within the project year (May 2025 – April 2026). This is to ensure organizational effectiveness, efficiency, and complementarity across all our activities

participating-org.narrative:
Building Blocks for Peace Foundation (BBFORPEACE) is a network of young people working on conflict prevention, peace building, climate adaptation, youth and women leadership, development, human rights and democratic governance in West Africa. The organisation hasbeen incorporated with the Corporate Affairs Commission in Nigeria since 2017.
Our vision is to see a world where there is peace, harmony, justice and respect for human rights with young people adequately involved.
Our mission is to achieve a peaceful society through innovative approaches like formal and non-formal peace building, policy advocacy, dialogue, research, education, training, workshops,media programming, sports, empowerment, technology, arts, coalition and movement building.
BBFORPEACE, with over eight (8) years of experience, is dedicated to building and sustaining peace across Nigeria and exists to: - transform power structures that exclude young people from decision-making; - build sustainable spaces for young people to shape decisions that affect them; - connectyouth to partner for peaceful and inclusive societies.
Our core values include; inclusion, tolerance, transparency, non-partisanship, pluralism,accountability, gender sensitivity, voluntarism, diversity and integrity
